 Order

Dated this the 10th day of October, 2024 This Criminal Miscellaneous Case has been filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, to quash all further proceeding in S.C.
No.508/2023 on the files of the Special Court for the trial of cases under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act [hereinafter referred as 'POCSO Act' for short], Erattupettah, arose out of Crime No.820/2023 of Mundakkayam Police Station, Kottayam.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioner herein is the sole accused in the above case.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor, in detail.
Perused the relevant materials available.

3. In this matter, the allegation of the prosecution is that, at about 11.30 pm on 27.02.2022, the accused herein, during his juvenility, trespassed upon the house of the victim, minor girl aged 16 years and subjected her to aggravated penetrative sexual assault by coitus.

Further allegation of the prosecution is that, during the last week of 2024:KER:77298 February, 2023, on two-three days at about 8.30 am, the accused reached the school of the victim and hugged and kissed her inside her classroom.
Thereafter, the accused trespassed into the courtyard of the house of the victim and attempted to see her.
It is further alleged that, between the period 27.05.2023 to 06.06.2023, the accused followed the victim to the PSC Coaching Centre at Mundakayam.

It is on this premise, the prosecution alleges commission of offences punishable under Sections 447, 450, 376(1), 376(2)(n),
354A(1)(i), 354A(2) and 354 of IPC as well as under Sections 3(a) read with 4, 5(l) read with 6, 7 read with 8, 9(l) read with 10, 11(iv) read with 12 of the POCSO Act.
4.

The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that, in this matter, two Final Reports have been filed against the petitioner, whose date of birth was 08.05.2004 and who attained majority on 07.05.2022, pertaining to the occurrence prior to 07.05.2022 before the Juvenile Justice Board and after 07.05.2023 before the Special Court alleging the same offences.

According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, allegation as to committal of aggravated penetrative sexual assault not 2024:KER:77298 made out from the initial FIS or in the 164 statement of the victim.
Therefore, the matter would require consideration by this Court to quash the proceedings.

5. Dispelling the contentions, the learned Public Prosecutor read out the additional statement of the victim and also the 164 statement supporting commission of offences alleged by the prosecution, to contend that, as per the additional statement, aggravated sexual assault on 27.02.2022, during the month of February, 2023 for two- three days and the period in between 27.05.2023 and 06.06.2023,
have been stated by the victim and in the 164 statement also the victim stated the same without specifying the dates.

6. On perusal of the statements of the victim as pointed out by the learned Public Prosecutor, the overt acts at the instance of the accused, during the last week of February, 2023, for a two-three days and between the period 27.05.2023 to 06.06.2023, have been stated.

sentences.text:
Going through the statements of the victim and other prosecution materials, it appears that,
prima facie, the prosecution allegations are made out, warranting trail as 2024:KER:77298 pointed out by the learned Public Prosecutor.
Therefore, this is not a fit case for quashment, since the matter warrants trial.
8. Accordingly, this Crl.M.C stands dismissed.
Registry shall forward a copy of this order to the Special Court for information and further steps.

Sd/-
 A. BADHARUDEEN SK JUDGE Anandhu.
